label: dosage heatmap
purpose: Sample × marker dosage heatmap with K=3 group track and polarity stripe. Partner of the PCA panel. Implements SPEC_0 §11 (centering / polarity).
input_contract: atlasState.inversion.dosage_heatmap_state = { mgl_heatmap_result? OR legacy_chunk?: {samples, markers, dosage}, selected_marker_indices?, ... } — adapters.js normalises both shapes

panels.purpose: top stripe, one cell per displayed marker; black = flipped
left K=3 group track (+ optional K=6)

subdir_files: adapters.js — normalises 2 input shapes (mgl_heatmap_json OR legacy_chunk) into the canonical painter input
renderer.js — canvas painter (heatmap + group track + polarity stripe)
selection.js — hover crosshair + click-to-toggle sample / marker
primitives_used: legacy candidate-chunk shape (no separate producer — direct from chrom JSON)

interactions.purpose: toggle either sample OR marker in selection set

known_issues: Reused by page_evolution_polarize_msa as a downstream painter (stacked-consensus rows fed in).
